items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: It would be like JOe Lewis - quite while you're ahead.

ctx.x: Well, you're going to play as long as you can play well-- that's your idea, isn't it?
Yeah. If I ever - within the next couple - three years or so, If I feel I'm slipping, I'll quit and I'm going to hang it up. It would be like JOe Lewis - quite while you're ahead.

Yeah. All right, well now, we've covered most of the travelling you've done in the last five years and your theory now is that you came back to this country now after living in Denmark for four years or close to five years -- you're going to move back to this country.
